title: PEE threads and bit threads in gravitational subregions of AdS
summary: Motivated by the kinematic-space description of gravitational subregions \cite{Basu:2026hbg}, we allow partial entanglement entropy (PEE) threads to be sourced not only from the asymptotic boundary, but also from boundaries of subregions. Based on this setup, we develop a framework to construct configurations for PEE threads and bit threads sourced from surfaces in the AdS bulk. The situations we have analyzed include the Poincaré AdS$_3$ and the planar BTZ black brane with an end-of-the-world (EOW) brane, and the entanglement wedges of boundary multi-intervals.
